propositions: Code review currently lacks a concurrency criterion to detect data races and synchronization discipline violations.

The proposed concurrency overlay uses a two-tier lexical trigger: a committed high-precision tier (synchronization primitives) and a project-extensible noisy tier (repository-specific vocabulary) to detect both explicit lock races and implicit unlocked-twin races.

The committed tier intentionally does not fire on modal unlocked-twin patterns (raw git operations, file stat-then-delete); the project-extensible tier in criteria_routing.json captures repository-specific race patterns including index.lock and stage_and_commit.

The overlay must be registered as advisory (block_threshold 0.95, blocking_enabled false) pending calibration, with Pass-1 reviewer prompt carrying the full lockset-first rubric and evidence-record contract.
